title: I made a free daily peg-shooting game that runs right inside Reddit: Pegfall
author: gholias
selftext:
Hey everyone! I just launched **Pegfall**, a minimalist daily arcade game that runs right inside a Reddit post. Aim, shoot, and watch the ball bounce through a field of pegs. Clear every orange peg to win, then keep going for a big board-clear bonus. Everyone gets the same board each day with one run to make it count, plus a daily leaderboard and streaks.

The game was made with Fable, using a custom workflow I built to bring my other games (mostly iOS) over to Reddit while keeping my studio's visual identity. Nothing too fancy, but it's been working well, and I'm happy to talk more about it if anyone's interested.

**Play today's board:** https://www.reddit.com/r/gatuno_games/comments/1ww6hzf/pegfall_daily_oct_2_2026/

Pegfall lives in r/gatuno_games, my community of free games you can play directly on Reddit, with several daily puzzles and arcade games: https://www.reddit.com/r/gatuno_games
